classification.difficultyReason: Combine exact ratios obtained from related angles, quadrant signs and unit-circle axis values.

content.prompt: Without using a calculator, find the exact value of:

answer.worked:
The related angle for $135^{\circ}$ is $45^{\circ}$. Tangent and cosine are negative in the second quadrant.

$$\begin{align*}\sin90^{\circ}\times\tan135^{\circ}\times\cos135^{\circ}&=1\times(-\tan45^{\circ})\times(-\cos45^{\circ})\\\sin90^{\circ}\times\tan135^{\circ}\times\cos135^{\circ}&=1\times(-1)\times\left(-\frac1{\sqrt2}\right)\\\sin90^{\circ}\times\tan135^{\circ}\times\cos135^{\circ}&=\frac1{\sqrt2}\end{align*}$$

The related angle for $330^{\circ}$ is $30^{\circ}$. Sine is negative in the fourth quadrant.

$$\begin{align*}\sin330^{\circ}\times\cos360^{\circ}&=-\sin30^{\circ}\times1\\\sin330^{\circ}\times\cos360^{\circ}&=-\frac12\times1\\\sin330^{\circ}\times\cos360^{\circ}&=-\frac12\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $45^{\circ}$. In the second quadrant, sine is positive and cosine is negative.

$$\begin{align*}2\times\sin135^{\circ}\times\cos135^{\circ}&=2\times\sin45^{\circ}\times(-\cos45^{\circ})\\2\times\sin135^{\circ}\times\cos135^{\circ}&=2\times\frac1{\sqrt2}\times\left(-\frac1{\sqrt2}\right)\\2\times\sin135^{\circ}\times\cos135^{\circ}&=-1\end{align*}$$

The related angle for $225^{\circ}$ is $45^{\circ}$. Sine and cosine are negative in the third quadrant. Also, $\tan180^{\circ}=0$ and $\sin90^{\circ}=1$.

$$\begin{align*}\cos225^{\circ}\times\tan180^{\circ}+\sin225^{\circ}\times\sin90^{\circ}&=\left(-\frac1{\sqrt2}\right)\times0+\left(-\frac1{\sqrt2}\right)\times1\\\cos225^{\circ}\times\tan180^{\circ}+\sin225^{\circ}\times\sin90^{\circ}&=0-\frac1{\sqrt2}\\\cos225^{\circ}\times\tan180^{\circ}+\sin225^{\circ}\times\sin90^{\circ}&=-\frac1{\sqrt2}\end{align*}$$

Both related angles are $60^{\circ}$. Sine is negative in the third quadrant and cosine is positive in the fourth quadrant.

$$\begin{align*}3\sin240^{\circ}-2\cos300^{\circ}&=3(-\sin60^{\circ})-2\cos60^{\circ}\\3\sin240^{\circ}-2\cos300^{\circ}&=3\left(-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)-2\left(\frac12\right)\\3\sin240^{\circ}-2\cos300^{\circ}&=-\frac{3\sqrt3}{2}-1\end{align*}$$
